[SWS_CM_80001] Signal-based network binding shall implement SOME/IP and
SOME/IP-SD
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00205, RS_CM_00004
⌈
The signal-based network binding shall implement the SOME/IP Service Discovery
Protocol defined in [6] and the SOME/IP Protocol defined in [4] (except for the serial-
ization of signal-based payload).
⌋
Length and Type fields shall always be in network byte order ([PRS_SOMEIP_00368]
applies).
